items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio - 2,292 stars today, still the page's top mover
items.summary:
VoiceStudio is the fully local elevenlabs alternative: voice cloning, dubbing and 646 languages, no api key.
2,292 stars in 24 hours took it to 88,382, and it was still being pushed to github this afternoon.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark - the anti-slop design skill is now second on the page
items.summary:
hallmark hands claude code, cursor and codex concrete css rules so pages stop looking like default ai output.
2,235 stars today on a 35.5k base, up from 1,317 when this morning's brief was built.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable - 1,551 stars for a design language agents can load
items.summary:
impeccable packages a shared design vocabulary an agent reads instead of guessing at taste.
1,551 stars today and 88,723 total, apache-2.0, with the repo pushed again this afternoon.

items.title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents - 1,376 stars, up from 381 this morning
items.summary:
TradingAgents puts a research desk of llm agents around a trade, with bull and bear analysts arguing before anything is bought.
1,376 stars today on 115,582 total, and trendshift has it climbing alongside the rest of the ai-agent page.

items.title: makecindy/cindy - 1,268 stars for the 'works out of the box' agent
items.summary:
cindy is pitched at people who do not want to spend an evening wiring tools into an agent first.
1,268 stars today took it from 5.1k to 6,015, so most of its audience found it this week.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail - 1,156 stars as a major vendor ships an agentic ide
items.summary:
thinkrail is an open-source, lightweight ide that customises itself around how you work and runs an agent inside the editor.
1,156 stars today against 51 this morning, and 2,492 in total.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC - 853 stars for an agent-harness tuning layer
items.summary:
ECC bundles skills, instinct files, memory, security checks and research habits into one optimisation layer for claude code, codex, opencode and cursor.
853 stars today on 289,454 total, the largest star base on the page.

items.title: pollen-robotics/microduck - the biped duck keeps moving
items.summary:
microduck is a desk-sized two-legged robot whose training and control code sits in the repo.
844 stars today and 12,233 total, with the official demo linked below.

items.title: trump says it is decision time on iran: a deal or finishing it off
items.summary:
trump told fox news on sunday he is choosing between making a deal with iran and finishing it off, and named pickaxe mountain as a possible target.
qatari mediators were in tehran the same day, and the last confirmed us strikes were on 1 september.
items.change: he put a deadline shape on the choice for the first time, nine days before the 3 november midterms.

items.title: saudi, pakistani and turkish officials are in tehran trying to stop a new war
items.summary:
khalid bin salman, pakistan's asim munir and turkey's ibrahim kalin met president pezeshkian in tehran on monday under the mecca joint defence agreement.
they are due to see security chief mohsen rezaei, and analysts read the visit as the last off-ramp before us strikes resume.
items.change: first joint visit by the three mecca pact signatories since the houthi campaign on saudi arabia began.

items.title: israel votes tomorrow, and the idf is not denying the zamir story
items.summary:
polls published friday had likud and eisenkot's yashar level, with about 70,000 israelis flying home to vote and half a million first-time voters.
reports that zamir warned washington a pre-election strike on iran would wreck the vote went unanswered by the idf, which said only that its planning is nonpartisan.
items.change: the zamir report broke overnight, netanyahu called it nonsense, and the idf neither confirmed nor denied it.

items.title: un investigators call west bank expulsions crimes against humanity
items.summary:
the un commission of inquiry said israeli forces committed extermination, torture and rape in the occupied west bank, in a report issued the day before the election.
it landed as the hebron clampdown widened, with crossings shut for election day and about 2,000 people displaced.
items.change: the un finding is new, and the west bank lockdown now covers election day itself.

items.title: houthi missile debris hits khamis mushait as the coalition strikes sanaa
items.summary:
saudi state tv showed damaged buildings and cars in khamis mushait after intercepted missiles fell on the city.
the saudi-led coalition said it destroyed four ballistic missile launchers and five tunnels in sanaa, and riyadh airport is working from two terminals again.
items.change: the coalition gave its first detailed strike claim, and debris damage was shown in a second saudi city.

items.title: egypt's parliament authorises military support for saudi arabia
items.summary:
the house of representatives voted on monday to let el-sisi send military support to saudi arabia if riyadh asks for it.
sisi has said any egyptian action would be limited to protecting saudi territory and would not strike yemen.
items.change: first time cairo has put military backing for riyadh to a vote in this round.

items.title: jordan arrests three suspects in the karak church attack
items.summary:
police found the men before dawn in an abandoned house in karak and wounded all three in a shootout; no officers were hurt.
the attack killed nine christians and injured 34, and no group has claimed it.
items.change: suspects are in custody, and the injury count was revised down from about 40 to 34.

items.title: five killed in gaza, including a 7-year-old, as strikes hit tent camps
items.summary:
an air strike on a camp for displaced people near khan younis killed four, among them a young girl, and a drone hit a tent in gaza city.
civil defence put the 24-hour toll at 11 dead and 50 wounded, and the health ministry total is 74,555.
items.change: the 24-hour civil defence count is new, and this round hit displacement camps rather than front lines.

items.title: chips lead a monday rally, and the s&p is back above 7,680
items.summary:
the s&p 500 is up 0.76% at 7,681.22 and the nasdaq up 0.99% at 26,211.87, with the vix down 5.6% to 18.37.
the soxx is up more than 3% on anthropic's filing, and range resources is up 15% on eqt's $50bn all-stock bid.

items.title: anthropic files to list as ANT, with $16.3bn of half-year revenue
items.summary:
the s-1 shows $16.29bn of revenue in the six months to june, up 1,304% from $1.16bn, and a loss of $80.7bn for the same period.
it carries $6.2bn of debt, lists openai and google as competition, and goldman sachs and morgan stanley are lead underwriters.

items.title: crude gives back its overnight slide as riyadh talks to tehran
items.summary:
wti is $102.9, down 0.4%, after trading near $100.6 overnight, and brent is roughly flat and about 2% above its asian low.
the us strategic petroleum reserve is at its lowest since 1982, so there is little cushion if hormuz traffic stops again.
items.change: prices turned on the saudi defence minister's arrival in tehran, not on any new supply news.

items.title: meta wants $95bn more for ai, and the chipmakers want in
items.summary:
meta will sell $35bn of stock and raise another $60bn through an at-the-market programme to fund ai infrastructure.
nvidia, amd and broadcom are interested in up to $5bn of the shares, and meta was down about 0.2% by midday after falling earlier.

items.title: musk's 'guppy-level death' call hits the neoclouds, then they bounce
items.summary:
coreweave, nebius and iren fell early after musk said 200-plus neoclouds face consolidation, then recovered with the wider tape.
coreweave and nebius are still down more than 30% this month, and spacex closed $40bn of gpu debt over the weekend.
items.change: musk put a number on the shakeout, and the sector's credit worries went mainstream.

items.title: verizon beats on profit, misses on revenue, and lifts guidance
items.summary:
verizon reported eps of $1.27 against a $1.21 consensus and raised its 2026 forecast, but revenue came in light and the stock is down 2.5%.
after the close it is cadence, nucor, welltower, public storage, celestica and hartford.
items.change: the pre-market name is in; the after-hours slate starts after 4pm et.

items.title: lula's comeback win knocks 25% off brazil's etf
items.summary:
lula took 51.8% to flavio bolsonaro's 48.2% after losing the first round, and brazilian assets sold off on the surprise.
the ewz etf fell 25%, the bovespa halted on a circuit breaker, the real dropped 10.5% and petrobras fell 16%.

items.title: the fed decides wednesday, and 163 s&p companies report this week
items.summary:
futures put a 90% chance on a hold at 3.75-4% when the fomc finishes on wednesday afternoon.
q3 gdp and the september pce index print thursday, with alphabet, amazon and microsoft reporting in the same stretch.
items.change: market-implied odds of a hold are now 90%, and this is the quarter's peak earnings week.

items.title: liverpool 2-0 brighton: an own goal, an isak finish and fourth place
items.summary:
a pascal gross own goal off wirtz's shot and isak's sixth of the season gave liverpool a fourth straight win in all competitions.
the clean sheet lifted them to fourth, two points above chelsea, and it was their first home league win since april.

items.title: wirtz says the ankle is not serious and he expects to play the next game
items.summary:
wirtz told sky deutschland he has been twisting the ankle for weeks, needs it sorted, and thinks he will be back for the next game.
iraola had called him a doubt for chelsea on wednesday after he came off on 65 minutes against brighton.

items.title: araujo has the kop, and liverpool have a £47m decision to make
items.summary:
araujo kept brighton out at right-back and iraola praised how he handled being asked to play out of position.
the echo has already put the £47m option to a reader poll, with the loan from barcelona running to the end of the season.

items.title: chelsea at anfield on wednesday in the league cup last 16
items.summary:
liverpool host chelsea at 20:00 uk on wednesday in the last 16, before arsenal visit in the league on sunday.
wirtz is a doubt for the cup tie, and the arsenal game is the bigger of the two with fenerbahce away in europe after it.

meta.next: chelsea (h) league cup last 16, wed 28 oct 20:00 uk

items.title: szoboszlai and frimpong are still out, and the list has not shortened
items.summary:
szoboszlai's hamstring and frimpong's muscle injury keep both out, with frimpong not due back until after the november break.
ekitike is unlikely to play again this year, bradley is still recovering and leoni is targeting mid-november.

items.title: elliott's valencia loan hits a red card in a relegation fight
items.summary:
elliott came on in the 69th minute at villarreal and was sent off in the 89th for two quick bookings in a 2-1 defeat.
aguirre called the red card absurd and ridiculous, and valencia are in a relegation fight.

items.title: liverpool tell valencia they will trigger otorbi's £25m clause
items.summary:
liverpool have told valencia they intend to pay the £25m release clause for the winger, according to the club's media watch round-up.
the clause is the only route, so no fee negotiation is expected.

items.title: liverpool are one of three clubs watching bayern's 18-year-old karl
items.summary:
monday's gossip has arsenal, liverpool and man united monitoring bayern munich's lennart karl, an 18-year-old german midfielder.
the report is a teamtalk round-up rather than a bid, and no fee or contact has been reported.
